kind: the measured result: the six-county residual, classified, with the P-300 split, the corpus re-check, the invariants and the write-proof
producedBy: hauska-factory scripts/p326/setback-residual-composition.mjs, run from the lane worktree at branch fix/p326-setback-refusal-classifier, commit 087927b plus the two new files (the artifact records the dirty tree, not just the hash)

snapshot.sessionReadOnly: on, read back before and after the reads

population.definition: six-program-county parcels whose setback rails carry kind='unaccounted' on all five rails
population.vintageOfTheCells: one per county, 2026-09-17T18:15:13Z (Bastrop) through 2026-09-17T18:40:57Z (Travis) -- the P-256 apply, hours before this read

upstreamZoning.reading: the 48,825 are the dispatch's 'no district on parcel' AND its 'unreadable source' at once, and neither is a class of its own because the write path never looks at the district for this branch. The 1,026 are Woodcreek (Hays), a city whose parcels DO carry districts and which therefore needs a real district table even though it has no ruled table.

classes.note: pre-registered as expected-empty (B2); measured empty. P-256 predicted the same.
pre-registered as expected-empty and measured empty: every one of the 58,339 cells carries a basis with a vintage of the P-256 apply, so no residual cell is an unvisited default.

p300.derivation: OT-10 applied mechanically: servable = no district on file (zoningDistrict cell is not a kind='value' with a non-blank code); needs-table = a district IS on file. Measured from the store per parcel, not inferred from the class.
p300.compositionOfTheServableShare: 48,825 whose zoningDistrict is refused for want of a staging layer + 4 whose district is not-applicable = 48,829, across 39 of the 40 no-ruled-table cities
p300.compositionOfTheNeedsTableShare: 8,484 district-miss (a real code with no row in an existing table: San Marcos, Austin, Bastrop, Cedar Park, Buda, Lockhart, Taylor, Hutto, Leander, Kyle and 9 more) + 1,026 in Woodcreek, where districts exist but no table does
p300.theOutsideCheckThisLanePreRegistered: P-300's own plan row names Gholson (McLennan) at 840 parcels, Sec. 3.01.002. This lane measures gholson-tx at exactly 840, which is the P-300 definition corroborated by a number this lane did not choose.
p300.whatItImpliesForTheRemainingWork: P-300's mechanism reaches 83.7 percent of the residual without a district table for any of those cities -- but not on the corpus row alone: 48,825 of that share are parcels whose zoning staging layer does not exist either, so the default line is the ONLY settable input for them until a zoning layer lands. The 9,510 that P-300 cannot reach are the table-authoring queue proper, and 8,484 of those are single districts missing from tables that already exist.

invariants.observed: 0 disagreeing parcels across all 981,405 parcels of the six counties, not only across the 58,339

districtMiss.method: resolveSetbackForParcel(jurisdictionKey, districtCode) against the installed corpus

corpusRecheck.reading: every recorded fingerprint re-derives from the corpus the cells themselves name (1.4.0). The classes are not a transcription of stored strings: they are the write path's own router agreeing, 58,339 times.

unclassified.proofItCanFire: test/setback-residual-composition.test.mjs drives three fingerprints of unimplemented classes and requires `unclassified` with a reason -- including a router codeClass of 'planned-development' on an unaccounted cell, which must NOT land in district-miss

writeProof.method: per county and per setback rail: md5 over string_agg(place_key || '|' || cell_state::text) ORDER BY place_key, restricted to kind='unaccounted'; plus the county's total parcel_record_cell row count. Both computed in the database, before and after the read.
writeProof.independentSpotCheck: the digest taken before the FIRST instrumented run equals the digest taken before the final run, two separate leases and connections apart: the store did not move while this lane read it
writeProof.whatItDoesNotCover: rows outside the six counties' setback rails; the artifact says so in notMeasured rather than implying whole-table immutability

violationCases: a router fingerprint with a codeClass no rule implements -> unclassified with a reason, and asserted NOT to be district-miss
the no-table method with a finding that lacks the no-table prefix -> unclassified
an unaccounted cell carrying codeClass 'planned-development' or 'non-district-raw-code' -> unclassified, because the writer maps those to refused and not-applicable
verifyByViolation.writerAgreementMatrix: classifyRouterMiss, imported from the job itself, is run over 22 district codes (including '', PUD, P-UD, PD, PDD, PC, ROW, WATER, NULL, UNZONED, B-3, SF-6); every fingerprint it leaves unaccounted must classify as district-miss or unresolved-raw-code, and every fingerprint it refuses or declines must classify as unclassified. The classifier is pinned to the writer function, not to a copy of its rules.
verifyByViolation.readOnlyByConstruction: a test asserts every exported SQL constant begins with SELECT and contains no insert/update/delete/drop/alter/create/truncate/grant/copy verb

contradictionsAndDeadEnds: The dispatch's expected class 'a table exists but the parcel carries no district' does not exist in the store, and its absence is the finding: the writer's no-table short-circuit means a district-less parcel is never classified as district-less. Reported, measured on the zoning rail instead, not patched.

A first draft of this instrument recorded only the factory commit in its snapshot, while the instrument itself was uncommitted. Caught before the final run: the artifact now records the working tree state, because a commit hash that does not contain the code that ran is exactly the stale-tree failure the dispatch warns about.

The heavy-scan lease looked unavailable (no FACTORY_CONTROL_API_URL/KEY in the environment), which the last three lanes recorded as a blocker. It was resolvable from gcloud; the TLS failure that followed is handled by the repo's own documented NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca workaround.
